candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: Which of these international agencies is Nigeria a member of?
candidate.explanation: Nigeria is a member of the International Monetary Fund. The Paris and London Clubs are creditor arrangements; a debtor country negotiating with them is not thereby a member of those creditor groups.
